result: the guard test went from timing out at 5000ms to 109ms

decision: deleted a test whose premise was false rather than weakening it to pass
why: a dry run cannot read under a held exclusive lock, because that is SQLite, not a property of this script; the narrower true claim is that a dry run never writes
evidence: migrate test, removal with the reasoning kept in place
result: one fewer test, no weakened assertion
